| Student of the Forest | Defeat every kind of creature that lives on Fairy Forest's maps. | - |
| The Wing Unsealed | Defeat the Unbound in the Rootbound Wing. | - |

## Discoveries

[The Heart Tree's Crown](../world/discoveries.md#heart-tree-crown), [The Carters' Rest](../world/discoveries.md#carters-rest), [A Carpet of Bluebells](../world/discoveries.md#bluebell-carpet), [Where the Lake Glows](../world/discoveries.md#shimmerwater-glow), [The Oak's Lookout](../world/discoveries.md#oak-lookout), [Where the Great Root Breaks the Surface](../world/discoveries.md#great-root)

Regional mastery, earned by making discoveries here:

- **Lantern-Lit** (2 discoveries): 1,500 mesos
- **Forest Listener** (4 discoveries): 6,000 mesos

A taxi from [Wren](../npcs/fairy_forest_cab.md) takes you to any other town for 150 mesos.
